statement: Liquid-cooling requirements are doubling in under a year as NVL72 Vera Rubin racks (2H 2026) arrive, with CDUs, manifolds, and connectors flagged as an extended-lead-time deployment bottleneck.
why: Cooling components are becoming a long-lead constraint on AI-server deployment as rack thermal density rises sharply.

impact.mechanism: Doubling cooling load plus extended CDU/manifold procurement lead times slow deployment of Rubin-class GPU racks.

evidence.excerpt: Cooling requirements are doubling in less than a year, with the NVL72 rack based on the Vera Rubin architecture, expected in the second half of 2026

confidence.basis: Headline plus one accessible quote; lead-time figures paywalled and remaining context is unverified web synthesis.
